bio: The Eliot restaurant and lounge at the Coed-Y-Mwstwr Hotel beckons with its cozy charm and inviting ambiance. The Lounge features a lovely warm open fire, this space is designed to envelop guests in comfort and relaxation. For those seeking a touch of nature, the option to have afternoon tea outside allows guests to soak in the serene surroundings while indulging in delectable treats.  The Afternoon Tea menu at the Coed-Y-Mwstwr Hotel offers a delightful array of options to suit every palate. Freshly baked scones and Welsh cakes served with clotted cream and preserves to delicate finger sandwiches filled paired with a selection of premium teas and coffees, the experience is elevated to a true celebration of taste and luxury, making it a memorable part of any visit.  High Tea enthusiasts will appreciate the inclusion of savoury pastries alongside the traditional scones and sweet treats, adding a savoury touch to the experience. For those looking for something a bit different, the hotel's "Gents Tea" presents a selection featuring lamb kofta, Welsh beef sliders, ham and cheese melt, accompanied by a hearty tankard of beer. This innovative twist on the classic afternoon tea caters to diverse tastes and ensures a memorable culinary journey for all guests.
